title: No independent day-outcome watchdog: the missed-pick alert (E3) and EOD health run once inside the scheduler, and the no-games-day early return skips both
tier_reason: an undelivered candidate on a no-games-day return, or any day whose scheduler dies or hangs before step 5b, ends with no alert; unfixed (backlogged 8/14); B -> A

contract.text: Every game day ends with a delivered pick, a scoreable commit or a recorded deliberate skip, and any other end state alerts the operator independently of the scheduler process (a durable-state check with alert retry).

mechanism.text: run_day returns after 'No games scheduled' (idling until tomorrow) before step 5b (_maybe_alert_missed_pick) and the EOD health block, so a leftover candidate pick on such a day gets no alert

E3 (step 5b) and EOD health each run once inside run_day; if the scheduler crashes, hangs or is stopped before reaching them nothing else checks the day's outcome from durable state (check-pick-entered keys on scoreable commits and ignores this case)

residual.text: Backlogged since 8/14 as a cron-side audit keyed on durable disk state with alert-delivery retry; not built by the season's end
Without it, a hung scheduler on a skip day is indistinguishable from a deliberate skip (I-065)

watchdog.trigger: from cron, independent of the scheduler: at the earliest candidate game's cutoff (first pitch - 5) and again at 23:59 ET, a candidate pick file exists for the date with no delivery record, no scoreable commit and no recorded deliberate skip
watchdog.recovery_assertion: an alert is delivered (retried until confirmed) and the date ends with a scoreable commit or an explicit operator pass

evidence.what: every in-process protection shares the scheduler's fate; the no-games-day early return bypasses step 5b and EOD health; a leftover candidate on a day the schedule fetch returns empty gets no protection
the 'No games scheduled' branch idles until the next wakeup and returns before step 5b and the health block
every install in the continuous logged chain 7/02 -> 9/22 (last: 4490aee) carries the in-process-only protections; no fix exists

notes: fetch_schedule raises on HTTP failure, so the early return fires only on a genuinely empty regular-season schedule
the 7/16 singleton-slate gap (I-077) and the 8/13 silent pass (I-083) are the observed cases this watchdog would have caught
fixtures: filled from Task 5/6 acceptance objects at build time
